projects.title: Output Trace: 2D Array Dimensions & length Property
projects.description: Predict the output produced by the following Java code snippet:
projects.code:
int[][] mat = new int[3][5];
System.out.println(mat.length + " and " + mat[0].length);
projects.exampleText: Array instantiated with 3 rows and 5 columns
projects.answer:
mat.length returns the number of rows (3), and mat[0].length returns the number of columns in the first row (5).

Output:
3 and 5
projects.learningOutcome: Understand that mat.length gives row count and mat[0].length gives column count.
